items.title: The audience shapes the information content of the honey bee waggle dance

items.title: Limited thermal tolerance in tropical insects and its genomic signature

items.why: Provides a case study in fungal biocontrol while inviting discussion of strain effects and the evidence needed before field application.

items.title: Mosquito–capsid interactions contribute to flavivirus vector specificity

items.why: Connects insect physiology to vector competence and shows why vector–pathogen relationships require species-specific evidence.
